units: 24 base bookings, two paired branches from identical prefix per booking, 8 base bookings at each of lengths 3,4,5
selection: Exactly one changed hotel size or duration slot, exactly one number (Arabic numeral or zero through ten) equal to annotated value. Manual check of texts before inference excluded a spurious 3-star annotation. Pool reused with least-used-first selection and no dialogue repeated within a pair except the shared prefix.
inputs: Verbatim current customer turn and preceding clerk turn, with project-created semistructured initial bill and explicit tariff. Human utterances recombined across independent original dialogues. Prefix shared between paired branches. Field labels and numeric annotations never supplied to predictors.
parser: Domain lexical cues, falling back to preceding clerk turn. Ambiguous or unknown leaves current state unchanged.
direct_model: Qwen3-1.7B bfloat16; zero-shot greedy full-prefix generation, thinking disabled, maximum 16 output tokens. Strict integer answer with optional currency adornments.
timing: Per item after initialization, wall clock including context formatting, tokenization, generate, output decoding and CUDA synchronization for direct. CPU includes input parsing, update and answer, with initial preparation timed separately; CPU candidate has precomputed canonical digit features. First warm generation excluded. Batch size one.
interpretation: Measures replay on a 2-editable-field billing layer. Source also includes initial requests and availability questions, interpreted as amendments to the current bill. This is not an end-to-end native dialogue benchmark.
